title: Wire Photo Intake into Dataset Candidate creation

verify.summary: Verifier-owned probe 22/22 (single candidate+created ref same-UoW, idempotent retry, new-photo control, audit-failure rollback+cleanup, revoked/archived->neither); focused GREEN 9, dataset_governance 64, photo+migration 26, plant_history+ft006 25, full backend 631/10 (all historical head-pins); anti-goals honored; LOW note only.

Adversarial probes all passed: same-UoW seam direction (rollback/commit), same-photo dedup, new-upload distinct, concurrent single row, no-grant deny; sole writer in dataset_governance/service.py, PhotoCatalogItem.can_train_on DB-constrained false, module boundaries intact, cross-spec consistent; no admitted findings.

purpose: Make accepted-photo persistence call the sole Dataset creation seam inside Photo Intake's existing artifact/database UoW while preserving Photo Intake ownership, cleanup, public output, and immutable can_train_on=false catalog assertion.
success_outcome: Each newly accepted photo source row atomically creates exactly one raw non-trainable photo_catalog_item Dataset Candidate and dataset_candidate_created ref; creation/audit failure rolls back the photo catalog and cleans generated artifacts, repeated seam delivery for the same photo returns the same candidate, and auth/archive/public response/catalog behavior is unchanged.
anti_goals: Photo API/schema/cursor changes, historical photo backfill, evidence association, lifecycle transition, curator execution, or a second Dataset writer.
evidence_required: FT-014-AC-005 RED: after TASK-047 and before this wiring, a successful accept_photo leaves zero candidate for its photo_id; GREEN: the same operation leaves one exact raw/default candidate and event ref in the same UoW; decisive comparison: source identity, persisted defaults, response equality, rollback/cleanup, same-photo seam retry and new-photo control; artifact: focused PostgreSQL/filesystem transcript under .tasks/TASK-050-T3-FT-014-W2/.
constraints: Photo Intake owns file/catalog transaction and generated-file cleanup; it passes only the service-side PhotoCatalogItem identity to Dataset Governance.
A new upload/photo_id is new evidence, not an idempotent retry; only repeated delivery of the same canonical photo row deduplicates.
invariants: PhotoCatalogItem.can_train_on remains immutable false and is not Dataset trainability authority.
Unauthorized/archived Plant photo acceptance creates neither photo nor candidate.
verification_targets: FT-014-AC-005: accepted/invalid/audit-failed/persistence-failed/unauthorized/archived photo matrix with exact candidate/event counts, artifact cleanup, same-source idempotency, new-source control, and unchanged HTTP/service result.
